verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that API reference documentation exists (llms.txt) and that a model page links to a "Try in playground" console. Neither shows an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples. The playground is an adjacent console feature rather than an interactive reference, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable spec backing an interactive explorer was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
